source(output(
		GRGR_ID as string,
		GRGR_EFF_DATE as timestamp,
		GRGR_TERM_DATE as timestamp,
		CSCS_ID as string,
		CSCS_EFF_DATE as timestamp,
		CSCS_TERM_DATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SET NOCOUNT ON EXEC WriteOff.Pr_FetchBrandingData',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of GRGR_ID} = GRGR_ID,
		{Copy of CSCS_ID} = CSCS_ID) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of GRGR_ID} as string,
		{Copy of CSCS_ID} as string,
		CSCS_ID as string,
		GRGR_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		{Copy of GRGR_ID},
		{Copy of CSCS_ID},
		CSCS_ID,
		GRGR_ID)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderOracleDestination
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of Check Number} as string,
		{Copy of Subscriber Id} as string,
		{Copy of Group Id} as string,
		{Received Date} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Copy of Receipt Reason} as string,
		{Copy of Amount} as string,
		{Copy of Payment Method} as string,
		{Copy of Receipt Code} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of FirstName} as string,
		{Copy of FallOutReason} as string,
		{Copy of ClassID} as string,
		{Copy of ContractID} as string,
		{Copy of TotalAmount} as string,
		{Copy of PlanName} as string,
		{Copy of RunDate} as string,
		{Copy of GroupID} as string,
		{Copy of LastDue} as string,
		{Copy of HCID} as string,
		{Copy of PPAInd} as string,
		{Copy of PlanType} as string,
		{Copy of OSBIndicator} as string,
		{Copy of WriteOffReason} as string,
		{Copy of BatchDate} as string,
		{Copy of LastName} as string,
		{Copy of MI} as string,
		{Copy of CoverageType} as string,
		{Copy of PBP} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
